title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Lead AI initiatives from concept to deployment, managing timelines, resources, and deliverables. Work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, engineers, data teams, and technology partners to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend AI platforms, cloud services, and commercial solutions aligned to business and technical requirements. Design and develop AI-based solutions and architecture blueprints for AI platforms, applications, integrations, and enterprise services, leveraging modern AI capabilities such as Generative AI, AI agents, and RAG. Provide architecture leadership across AI solutions, data, integrations, APIs, and governance processes, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and business objectives. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet functional, non-functional, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements. Produce and maintain solution design documents, architecture diagrams, integration specifications, and technical governance artifacts. Drive AI adoption initiatives by identifying practical use cases and enabling responsible, secure, and scalable implementation across the organization. Mentor and guide junior team members in AI methodologies, best practices, and tools. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience designing enterprise solutions, cloud-native applications, AI-enabled platforms, data-driven systems, or digital transformation initiatives. Strong understanding of AI technologies including Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG architectures, enterprise AI platforms, Copilot technologies, responsible AI practices, and emerging AI trends. Experience with modern software development platforms and technologies such as Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, cloud-native services, APIs, and enterprise integration technologies. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including AI, integration, security, data, and application services. Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and familiarity with AWS or Google Cloud is desirable. Solid understanding of data structures, data modeling, and software architecture principles. Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and model deployment strategies. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Ability to communicate architecture decisions effectively to both technical and business stakeholders. Experience developing solution architecture documents, technical designs, and architecture diagrams. Experience leading architecture reviews, design governance, and cross-functional technology initiatives. Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, API-based architectures, security principles, and data governance. Experience evaluating vendor products, SaaS platforms, and AI solutions. 
 Contact - kapil.vhatkar@fidelsoftech.com / 9545945394

title: Senior Solution Architect - AI & Modern Technologies
description:
Job Description: We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect with strong hands-on coding expertise and experience designing and developing scalable, secure, and high-performance applications using modern technologies. 
 The ideal candidate should have a solid software engineering background, expertise in cloud-native architectures, and practical experience building and deploying AI agents and LLM-powered applications. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can drive architecture decisions while actively contributing to development and implementation. Key Responsibilities: Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance software architectures aligned with business requirements. Develop production-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems using modern programming languages and frameworks. Build and integrate AI agents, agentic workflows, and LLM-powered solutions into enterprise applications. Implement AI capabilities such as tool calling, RAG, workflow orchestration, and integration with enterprise systems. Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, AI frameworks, and architectural patterns. Lead technical design discussions, conduct code reviews, and establish engineering standards and best practices. Collaborate with product managers, stakeholders, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, and security. Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, and DevOps practices. Mentor developers and provide technical guidance throughout the software development lifecycle. Required Technical Skills: 1. Software Development Strong hands-on coding experience in one or more languages: Python, Java, C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Excellent understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and design patterns. Experience developing, debugging, and optimizing production-grade applications. 2. Solution Architecture Expertise in microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and RESTful APIs. Experience designing scalable, highly available, and secure enterprise applications. Knowledge of domain-driven design, system integration, and architectural documentation. 3. AI Agents & Generative AI Hands-on experience developing and deploying AI agents for real-world applications. Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, and agent orchestration. Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent. Knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise data integration. Understanding of AI agent evaluation, guardrails, security, and performance optimization. Experience integrating LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini. 4. Cloud & DevOps Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. Familiarity with automated testing, logging, monitoring, and deployment practices. 5. Databases & Integration Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or Redis. Knowledge of third-party API integrations and enterprise system connectivity. Familiarity with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging technologies is an advantage. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 10+ years of software development experience, including significant experience in solution architecture or technical leadership. Proven track record of delivering production-ready applications using modern technology stacks. Experience deploying and maintaining AI agent solutions in production environments. Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Key Requirement: Strong hands-on coding skills and practical experience developing AI agents are essential. Candidates with architecture-only experience and limited coding exposure will not be suitable.

Key Skills: Restfull API,Python,SQL,Solution Architecting,Java,Cloud Platforms,DevOps,System Design
